library(vitae)

education <- data.frame(degree=c("PhD","Masters","Masters","Bachelors"),
                                 type=c("Economics","Economics","Public Policy", "Economics"),
                                 inst=rep(c("University of Michigan","University of Chicago"),each=2),
                                 year=c(2007,2004,2000,1999)
                       )

experience <- data.frame(
  what="economist",
  when=c("June 2019 - present ","September 2007 - May 2019") ,                      
  with=c("Bureau of Economics, Federal Trade Commission","Antitrust Division, U.S. Department of Justice"),
  where=rep("Washington DC",2),
  why=c("",
  "Work closely with attorneys to model and quantify the effect of  mergers and other potentially anti-competitive behavior.",
  "Analyze the effects of various tariffs proposed by the Trump administration.",
  "Antitrust casework  focuses on collusion and monopolization in financial markets, as well as merger analysis  in the health insurance, advertising, airlines, and electricity industries.",
  "Authored code and documentation implementing numerous models to calibrate and simulate the effect of horizontal mergers. Versions of this code has been used in numerous antitrust investigations as well as in litigation.",
 "Authored code and documentation implementing numerous models to calibrate and simulate the effect of tariffs and quotas.",
"Designed and coded web interfaces for merger and tariff simulation.",
"Designed and maintained large databases (over 10 TB) for use in investigations and litigation."))

presentations <- data.frame(what = c("Federal Trade Commission","International Competition Network","International Industrial Organization Conference","Federal Communication Commission","U.S. Department of Justice"),
                            when=   c("6/2018, 7/2018","2018","2018","8/2018, 2013","2012, 2017")
)

service <- data.frame(what=c("US DoJ/KFTC Knowledge Exchange Program","Algorithmic Document Review","R Training"),
                      when=c(2018,2017,"2012 - present"),
                      why= c("Organized, co-authored and co-taught a 3 day training program for new economists at the Korean Free Trade Commission (KFTC). The purpose of this program was to train KFTC economists in how to analyze horizontal mergers.",
                             "Trained a series of machine learning classifiers to predict if a document is pertinent to an investigation. Once these models have been fully tested, they will greatly reduce the time needed to review the massive amount of documents received by the Antritrust Division.",
                             "Authored and co-taught a series of short courses for Economists  and Research Analysts on R. Covered topics included: data analysis, plotting, regression analysis, mapping, interfacing with databases, and antitrust analysis.")
                      )
awards <- data.frame(when=c(2017:2014,2010),
                     what=c("Team Award for work on Anthem/Cigna litigation",
                            "EAG Management Award For Extraordinary Achievement",
                            "Team Award for work on National Cinemedia/Screenvision litigation",
                            "Team Award for work on American/US Airways litigation",
                            "EAG Management Award For Pushing Frontiers"
                            )
                     )

## Software
```{r rpkgs}
pkgsearch::ps("Taragin",size = 100) %>%
  filter(purrr::map_lgl(package_data, ~ grepl("Charles Taragin", .x$Author, fixed = TRUE))) %>%
  arrange(desc(downloads_last_month)) %>%
  detailed_entries(
    what = paste(package,title,sep=": "),
    when = lubridate::year(date),
    why = description
  )
```
